# Min Ventures

Min Sihu's founder portfolio — ActaRoot, Inc. and OHWUT.

## Building ventures with a clear purpose.

Official page: https://min.ventures/

Min Sihu is the founder of ActaRoot, Inc. and OHWUT. This is the home for the businesses and brands he builds.

### Founded ventures

Two distinct identities, one founder: ActaRoot, Inc. is the U.S. company behind OHWUT, while OHWUT is the shopping platform and consumer brand.

- View the ventures: https://min.ventures/ventures/

### A founder-led portfolio

Based in South Korea, Min Sihu works across company building and consumer commerce. He identifies himself as Founder & CEO of OHWUT.

- About Min Sihu: https://min.ventures/about/
- Official personal profile: https://msihu.com/

### An official network

Company information belongs to ActaRoot. The shopping experience belongs to OHWUT. Personal biographical information is published at msihu.com.

- ActaRoot, Inc.: https://actaroot.com/
- OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/

## Founded ventures.

Official page: https://min.ventures/ventures/

A portfolio of companies and brands founded by Min Sihu, with each business identified by its actual role.

### ActaRoot, Inc.

ActaRoot, Inc. is a U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu. It serves as the corporate entity behind OHWUT, rather than as the shopping storefront.

- Visit ActaRoot: https://actaroot.com/

### OHWUT

OHWUT is a consumer-facing online shopping platform and brand serving the United States. It combines conventional shopping with purchase offers whose pricing responds to participation.

- Explore OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/

### Company and brand

ActaRoot and OHWUT are not two separate corporations. ActaRoot, Inc. is the operating company; OHWUT is the consumer shopping business and brand.

- About the founder: https://min.ventures/about/

---

## Min Sihu.

Official page: https://min.ventures/about/

Founder and entrepreneur based in South Korea.

### Founder

Min Sihu, also written as Sihu Min and 민시후, founded ActaRoot, Inc., a U.S. corporation, and OHWUT, the shopping platform and brand.

He identifies himself as OHWUT Founder & CEO. His founder portfolio is presented here; his official personal profile is at msihu.com.

- Official personal site: https://msihu.com/

### What he builds

His work connects a U.S. corporate organization with a consumer shopping experience designed around everyday purchases and participation-linked price reductions.

The ventures are shown as an evolving founder portfolio, with each business linked to its official domain.

- Founded ventures: https://min.ventures/ventures/
